rationale: The agent identified the user and retrieved order/product details, then executed an exchange. However, it failed key policy requirements: (1) No explicit confirmation from the user before performing the order-changing write (the exchange), including auto-selecting a payment method without confirmation; (2) It did not attempt or clarify the option to place a new order first as the user preferred, nor explain inability to do so; (3) It provided no final information about the outcome (new item details, order/exchange ID, charges, shipping). The closing message is a generic farewell, so the request was not completed in line with the stated policy.
